mode: w13scan deep discovery with non-invasive plugins
regressions_fixed_during_run: Shared login redirects are filtered from directory discovery.
CSS selector #stacktrace no longer triggers a debug-stack finding.
Express directory listing pages are recognized.
Trailing-slash aliases share one directory finding.
Unique same-origin redirect destinations are retained as discovered endpoints.
Prometheus metrics and the Juice Shop Swagger UI are classified from response evidence.
Referenced JavaScript bundles and static assets are crawled; blank query parameters are retained.
Current resource parents are checked before global directories, exposing nested DVWA listings.
Nuclei, Nikto and ZAP response-hygiene observations are represented as typed findings.
limits: This is an unauthenticated scan from the two application roots.
Findings are direct HTTP evidence, not OWASP challenge completion counts.
No labelled full challenge set exists here, so recall and false-positive percentages are not reported.
